text:
Danila Yurov came over from Magnitogorsk last season and is giving the 12-3-4 Wild goals from the third line: six in 19 games, three on the power play, at under 15 minutes a night.

The finishing is hot. Six goals on 3.3 expected (the quality of his chances) means he's shooting 21% against 15% last season, and that rate rarely lasts. Over his last ten games he has only two points, though his ice time is up almost two and a half minutes, so the team trusts him more even as the scoring cools.

He's 22, the 24th pick in 2022. Evolving-Hockey had him 93rd among 401 forwards in wins above replacement last season, mostly on defense, while noting the offense around him was weak. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking adds that he gets to the front of the net often (89th percentile) and exits the zone cleanly. Our projection sees about 19 goals, which would be a good second season for a player who was a question mark coming over.
